SELECT 
  schools.CDSCode,
  schools.School,
  schools.County,
  schools.District,
  schools.OpenDate,
  schools.StatusType,
  schools.Latitude,
  schools.Longitude,
  schools.Enroll12,
  schools.NumTstTakr,
  schools.AvgScrRead,
  schools.AvgScrMath,
  schools.AvgScrWrite,
  schools.NumGE1500,
  frpm.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)`,
  CASE 
    WHEN frpm.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` > 75 THEN 'High FRPM'
    WHEN frpm.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` BETWEEN 50 AND 75 THEN 'Medium FRPM'
    ELSE 'Low FRPM'
  END AS FRPM_Ranking
FROM 
  schools
JOIN 
  frpm ON schools.CDSCode = frpm.CDSCode
JOIN 
  satscores ON schools.CDSCode = satscores.cds
WHERE 
  schools.Charter = 1 AND schools.County = 'Fresno County Office of Education'
ORDER BY 
  frpm.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` DESC;	----- bird -----	california_schools

SELECT 
  schools.School,
  schools.Street,
  schools.City,
  schools.Zip,
  schools.State,
  schools.MailStreet,
  schools.MailCity,
  schools.MailZip,
  schools.MailState,
  schools.Website,
  schools.Enrollment,
  schools.NumTstTakr,
  schools.AvgScrRead,
  schools.AvgScrMath,
  schools.AvgScrWrite,
  schools.NumGE1500,
  CASE 
    WHEN schools.Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12) > 70 AND schools.NumGE1500 / schools.NumTstTakr > 0.2 THEN 'High-performing despite high FRPM'
    WHEN schools.Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12) < 30 AND schools.NumGE1500 / schools.NumTstTakr < 0.1 THEN 'Low-performing despite low FRPM'
    ELSE 'Expected performance'
  END AS Performance
FROM 
  schools
JOIN 
  satscores ON schools.CDSCode = satscores.cds
WHERE 
  schools.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 0
  AND schools.Enrollment > 100
  AND schools.`FRPM Count (K-12)` = (SELECT MAX(`FRPM Count (K-12)`) FROM schools WHERE `Charter School (Y/N)` = 0 AND Enrollment > 100)	----- bird -----	california_schools

SELECT 
    s.County,
    s.School,
    s.Enrollment,
    s.`Free Meal Count`,
    s.`Percent (%) Eligible Free`,
    s.`Charter School (Y/N)`,
    s.AvgScrRead,
    s.AvgScrMath,
    s.AvgScrWrite,
    s.NumGE1500,
    CASE 
        WHEN s.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` > 75 THEN 'High'
        WHEN s.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` BETWEEN 50 AND 75 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS FRPM_Level,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.County ORDER BY s.Enrollment DESC) AS Enrollment_Rank,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.County, FRPM_Level ORDER BY s.AvgScrRead + s.AvgScrMath + s.AvgScrWrite DESC) AS SAT_Rank
FROM 
    schools s
JOIN 
    satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE 
    s.Enrollment > 500
    AND (s.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` > 60 OR ss.NumGE1500 > 30)
GROUP BY 
    s.County, s.School, s.Enrollment, s.`Free Meal Count`, s.`Percent (%) Eligible Free`, s.`Charter School (Y/N)`, s.AvgScrRead, s.AvgScrMath, s.AvgScrWrite, s.NumGE1500, FRPM_Level
ORDER BY 
    s.County, Enrollment_Rank, SAT_Rank;	----- bird -----	california_schools

SELECT

    AVG(schools.Enrollment) AS Average_Enrollment,
    SUM(CASE WHEN schools.Charter = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Charter_Schools,
    SUM(CASE WHEN schools.Charter = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Non_Charter_Schools,
